verdict.rationale: An entity-and-registration compliance dashboard is a fair question for a registered-agent service, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence for it: the first-party site returned a Cloudflare challenge at robots.txt and nothing was fetched. The only community item mentions the company's SEO and says nothing about a dashboard, standing, or deadline tracking.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, one dashboard shows every entity and state registration with its standing and upcoming deadlines
